evidence: Matches the 'TX fees and policy' label and directly modifies the fee estimation implementation in src/policy/fees/.
rationale: Prevents the combined fee estimator from failing or severely underbidding prevailing fees when the mempool estimator is unready. According to the PR description, queries during startup or after a failed mempool load currently return errors or fall back to the relay floor, an issue confirmed by downstream LDK developers and marked for backport.
